typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DATA FROM  (SELECT \'member_nbr|SSN|hicn|mbid|medicaid_id|medicaid_state_code|member_first_name|member_last_name|member_middle_name|member_name_suffix|member_date_of_birth|member_sex|member_address1|member_address2|member_city|member_state|member_zip_code|member_zip_code_extn|member_mailing_address1|member_mailing_address2|member_mailing_city|member_mailing_state|member_mailing_zip_code|member_mailing_zip_code_extn|member_primary_phone|member_email|plan_name|plan_code|attributed_cco\' AS DATA, 0 AS ORDERNUM   UNION    SELECT ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_nbr]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[SSN]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[hicn]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[mbid]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[medicaid_id]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[medicaid_state_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_first_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_last_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_middle_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_name_suffix]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_date_of_birth]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_sex]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_address1]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_address2]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_city]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_state]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_zip_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_zip_code_extn]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_address1]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_address2]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_city]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_state]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_zip_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_mailing_zip_code_extn]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_primary_phone]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[member_email]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[plan_name]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[plan_code]),\'\') + \'|\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[attributed_cco]),\'\') AS DATA, 1 AS ORDERNUM FROM ##MO_SDOH_FINAL) A ORDER BY ORDERNUM',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(DATA = DATA) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA)) ~> FlatFileDestination
